meta.title: Split slow tests into separate files
meta.body_summary: Split field-error and zod-effects test suites into separate files to mitigate slow test file execution and allow parallel runs.

perf_labels.notes: Mechanical test reorg without performance evidence; self-merged by maintainer within 5 minutes, no review required.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 297 changed lines, this is a small test-only refactor by absolute volume. It fits a lightweight, no-review test parallelization PR and is consistent with the fast self-merge outcome.

review_details.performance_claim: Splitting slow tests into separate files to reduce suite execution time and enable parallel test running.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Test file reorganization does not demand benchmarks or manual verification; merged immediately due to maintainer trust and low-risk nature.

core_change_summary.description: Split the field-error test suite into specialized files (clear-server, without-js) and extract refinement tests from zod-effects.spec.ts to reduce per-file test load and enable parallel execution.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes are confined to spec files inside apps/web/app/routes/examples.
change_trajectory: Single commit (72a20d9b) splits field-error.spec.ts into specialized files and moves refinement tests from zod-effects.spec.ts to a new file.
